# integration tests depend on external Postgres availability

Tests skip when Postgres is unreachable (the pytest mark checks database connectivity). Relying on a running external database makes these integration tests brittle and environment-dependent.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental._db_available`
